book.name: Johaanas
book.title: Khoes khabar djaise Johaanas liekhies hai

content: Jiesoe Tieberias samoendar lage
Ekare baad djab tjela log Tieberias samoendar ke lage raha tab Jiesoe apane ke phien se dekhaais. Ie sab aise bhail:
Siemon Petras, djorwa Tomaas, Gaalielea sahar Kaana ke Naataanaajel aur Sebedeas ke doeigo betwan aur doeigo doesar tjela bhie hoewa raha.
Tab Siemon Petras ekwan se bolies: „Ham djaaila matjharie maare.” Tab ekwan bolies: „Attjha, hamahoelog tjalab.” Oelog bot me tjal gail. Bakie oe raat me oesab koetjh na pakaries.
Djab andjor howe lagal tab Jiesoe samoendar ke kienaare thara raha, bakie tjela log oke na tjienhies.
Tab oe djor se bolies: „E bhaai log, toelogke koetjh khaaik hai?” Tab oesab bolies: „Na, koetjh na.”
Tab oe bolies: „Djaal dahiena bagal bieg, tab toelog koetjh matjharie paihe.” Oesab oisane karies aur etana matjharie djaal me aail kie oesab hietjke bot me na laai paais!
Tab Jiesoe ke pjaara tjela Petras se bolies: „Oe to Prabhoe hai!” Djab Siemon Petras ie baat soenies tab haalie se kapra pahienke paanie me koed gail.
Ekwa tjela log bot se kienaare gail aur matjharie ke djaal hietjat laail. Oesab lagbhag ek sau meter kienaare se raha.
Djab oesab bot me se niekaral tab dekhies kie hoewa matjharie aur bret koila ke aagie ke oeppar hai.
Tab Jiesoe bolies: „Ekaat matjharie laaw.”
Siemon Petras bot me gail aur djaal kienaare ghaitjies. Oman ek sau tierpan (153) barka matjharie raha, aur tabbo djaal na phaatal raha.
Tab Jiesoe bolies: „Aaw, toelog kha le.” Ekko tjela na poetjhies kie: „Toe ke baate?” Oesab djaanat raha kie oe Prabhoe hai.
Tab oe bret aur matjharie leike sabke baaties. Aur oesabhan bhodjan karies.
Ie tiesara dafe raha kie Jiesoe maral logan me se djie oethe ke baad apane ke aapan tjela log ke dekhaais.
Jiesoe aur Petras ke baat-tjiet

Tab djab oesab khaai tjoekal raha tab Jiesoe Siemon Petras se poetjhies: „Johaanas ke beta Siemon, toe hamme sattje ke tjaahe hai, ekwan se djaada?” Tab Petras bolies: „Prabhoe, toe djaane hai kie ham toke pjaar kariela.” Tab Jiesoe bolies: „Tab hamaar bhera ke battjan ke tjaraihe.”

Aur oe phien se poetjhies: „Johaanas ke beta Siemon, toe hamme sattje ke tjaahe hai?” Tab Petras bolies: „Djie ha, Prabhoe, toe djaane hai kie ham toke pjaar kariela.” Tab oe bolies: „Tab hamaar bherwan ke dekh-bhaal kariehe.”

Ekare baad oe tiesara dafe poetjhies kie: „Johaanas ke beta Siemon, toe hamme pjaar kare hai?” Djab Jiesoe tiesara dafe ie baat poetjhies tab Petras ke doekh bhail aur bolies: „Prabhoe djie, toe sab tjiedj djaane hai. Toe djaane hai kie ham toke pjaar kariela.” Tab oe bolies: „Tab hamaar bherwan ke tjaraihe.”

Oe bhie bolies: „Soen, ham tose sattje ke boliela kie djab toe djawaan rahiele tab aapan gor par thara rahiele aur aapan rasta djaat rahiele. Bakie djab toe boerhwa hoi djaihe tab toke aapan man waala tjhore ke parie. Doesar koi toke kapra pahienaai aur aisan djagaha ledjaai djaaha toe na djaai mangiehe.”

Ie baat se oe aagam se bataais Petras kaise maar dhaaral djaai dekhaawe khaatien kie Parmeswar ketana maahaan hai. Jiesoe ekgo doesar tjela ke biese me ka bolies Oe bhie bolies: „Hamaar rasta par tjalte rahoe.”
Tab Petras ghoemke dekhies kie Jiesoe ke pjaara tjela bhie aawe hai. Ohie Paasan ke bhodjan ke same Jiesoe ke lage satke poetjhies raha: „Prabhoe djie, toke ke tjoegalie kariega?”
Djab Petras oke dekhies, tab Jiesoe se poetjhies: „Prabhoe djie, okare saath ka hoi?”
Tab oe bolies: „Djab ham maangiela kie oe djieje djab talak ham na lautke aabe, tab oe hamaar kaam hai. Toe khaalie hamare saath tjal.”

Ekare baad iesaai bhaai log apane me ie baat dwaara sotje lagal kie ie tjela na marie. Bakie Jiesoe aise na bolies raha. Oe khaalie bolies raha kie: „Djab ham maangiela kie oe djieje djab talak ham na lautke aabe, tab oe hamaar kaam hai.”
Aakhrie baat
Ehie tjela sab tjiedj dekhke ie poestak me liekhies hai. Aur hamlog djaaniela kie okar baat satj hai.
Jiesoe bahoet auro kaam karies hai. Bakie djab har ek tjiedj liekhaat tab hamare djaan me doenia par djagaha na rahat ie sab poestak dhare khaatien.

footnotes.text: Bhera ke matlab okar bieswaasie log hai.
